notes:
全新界面，两步验证，连接更稳。

- 全新界面：「我的」页重做，账户卡一眼看清剩余流量、到期与续费；全部页面统一卡片布局，宽屏两列、手机单列，亮暗主题对比度校正。
- 两步验证：在「我的 → 两步验证」直接开启、查看或重新生成恢复码、解除，可一键在验证器中打开。
- 连接更稳：内核 API 异常时不再反复重启掐断连接；桌面 TUN 自检指数退避；IPv6 地址轮换不再触发切网清理；退出不遗留服务模式内核；安卓磁贴不再卡在「连接中」；macOS 恢复后还原系统 DNS。
- 登录：入口慢时不再重复发送登录请求；退出登录同时作废服务端会话；强制升级检查依次尝试所有入口。
- 隐私：关闭诊断后立即停止一切上报；脱敏更彻底；本地可用配置仅本人可读。
- 修复礼品卡改码、批量更新提示、点当前节点断连、工单/消息/返利/会员中心不刷新等问题；订阅下载设 32 MB 上限。
notesEn:
A redesigned app, two-step verification, and a steadier connection.

- New look: the Me tab is rebuilt around an account card that shows remaining data, expiry and a renew button, with entries grouped into Account, Connection, Help & support and App. Every other screen — home, nodes, store, member hub, wallet, tickets, messages, settings and video — now shares one card layout and spacing, uses two columns on wide screens, and has corrected light and dark contrast.
- Two-step verification: turn it on, view or regenerate recovery codes, or turn it off under Me → Two-step verification, and open the key straight in your authenticator app.
- Steadier connection: no more repeated core restarts that dropped every connection when the core API stalled; the desktop TUN self-check backs off exponentially; IPv6 temporary-address rotation is no longer treated as a network change; quitting no longer leaves a service-mode core running; the Android quick tile no longer sticks on "Connecting"; macOS restores system DNS after recovering.
- Sign-in: a slow entry point no longer causes duplicate sign-in requests; signing out also revokes the server session; forced-upgrade checks try every entry point.
- Privacy: turning off diagnostics stops all reporting immediately; paths, passwords and subscription tokens are redacted more thoroughly; the saved working config is readable only by you.
- Fixes for gift-card code changes, bulk update and import results, tapping the current node, and refreshing tickets, messages, rebates and the member hub; subscription downloads are capped at 32 MB.
